items.quote: My clients are busy... I don't want to bother them with calls.
items.statement: Clients are busy and agents should not bother them with calls.

items.quote: Well... if not you, someone will. That agent will build the relationships and sell!
items.statement: If you do not engage your clients, other agents will build the relationships and sell.

overview: Observation on client engagement and sales strategy from a LinkedIn post.
